<function name="OnRestore" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when the entity is reloaded from a Source Engine save (not the Sandbox saves or dupes) or on a changelevel (for example Half-Life 2 campaign level transitions).

For the <page>duplicator</page> callbacks, see <page>ENTITY:OnDuplicated</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
</function>
